title: Broncos schedule leak: Denver to host Buffalo Bills on Christmas Day

sources.title: Broncos schedule leak: Denver to host Buffalo Bills on Christmas Day
sources.description: My least favorite day of covering football is on Christmas Eve or Christmas Day and it seems like the NFL loves to put the Denver Broncos in on either every single year! This year, we’ll have an AFC Divisional Playoff rematch with the Buffalo Bills coming back to Denver to try to exact revenge for […]
